headline: Sensex tumbles over 1,100 points, Nifty drops below 22,800 amid US-Iran conflict and FII outflows

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

whatHappening: BSE Sensex fell over 1,100 points while NSE Nifty 50 dropped below 22,800

Indian shares slid to near a six-month low during Monday trading session
August IIP growth jumped to 8% driven by surge in manufacturing and power output
summary:
Indian equity markets suffered a sharp sell-off on Monday as Sensex tumbled 1,100 points and Nifty fell below 22,800.
The crash was triggered by rising oil prices due to US-Iran tensions, FII outflows, and weak global market cues.
Despite the market mayhem, domestic macro data showed August IIP growth surging to 8% driven by manufacturing.
